description: Three procedures whose bodies each write a name the boundary hides, and only two are diagnosed (spec/execution-model.md:492-499). `silent`'s plain `:d = 5` creates its own binding — correct, and undiagnosable per spec/execution-model.md:443-446 — while `loud`'s `:d.k = 5` and `louder`'s `:lst[1] = 9` resolve their base as a read first and raise `ol-var-not-visible` on the base, each naming its own procedure (spec/error-model.md:132). Written as one program so the contrast is asserted rather than distributed across fixtures a reader must find: a checker that diagnosed every write, or none, fails on the count.
